jobs.description: *tringgggg…* The alarm goes off early, and that doesn't make anyone happy. But for you, it’s not a problem! You get out of bed every morning with a big smile on your face. NICE! jobs.description: Every dessert served on a plane starts somewhere, and at our client, that’s with you. You make sure every ingredient and product arrives on time and at the right price. This isn’t a department that has been running on autopilot for years: purchasing is being formally set up right now, and you’ll help build it from day one.- Source products and build lasting relationships with suppliers- Request and compare quotes, and negotiate until the deal is right- Run the numbers on prices and margins, so you know exactly what each decision is worth- Attend trade fairs to discover new products and suppliers- Help design the purchasing process and roll it out together with your colleagues- Work closely with production, quality and sales on a daily basisPurchasing comes naturally to you. You know when a price is too high, you are not afraid to challenge suppliers, and you enjoy a good negotiation.In addition:- You have at least MBO+ level of working and thinking, preferably with a completed HBO degree.- You have proven experience as a buyer, preferably within the food or manufacturing industry.- You are confident working with numbers and calculations.- You have a good command of written and spoken English. Dutch is an advantage.- You are able to work independently and maintain a clear overview of your responsibilities.- You enjoy building and developing something rather than simply maintaining existing processes.
